description: This file defines the MembershipModel class, which models membership data within the OrangeHRM system's API layer. It implements the Normalizable interface, uses traits for serialization, and constructs with a Membership entity to set up properties such as id and name.

classes.name: MembershipModel
classes.description: A model class representing membership data for the API, initializing with a Membership entity and defining serialization filters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that takes a Membership entity, sets it as the current entity for serialization, and defines the filterable properties 'id' and 'name'.
